text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it raised its rating for Faulding Inc to outperform from outperform (long term), and raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates.
-- Gruntal increased the estimate for fiscal 1997 to $0.08 a share from $0.05, and raised 1998 to $0.50 from $0.40.
-- Both moves reflect expectations for significant earnings growth in the wake of recent drug approvals by federal regulators, Gruntal said.
-- Faulding should benefit from its presently small sales base of only $76 million compared to the large product opportunities it is targeting, currently more than $2 billion, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal raised its two-year price target on the stock to $17 from $12.
-- Fauldings is a generic drug manufacturing company.
-- Its shares were up 3/8 at 8-3/4 Wednesday afternoon.
